Selected: \${fruit || '—'}

` @customElement({ name: 'select-demo', template: TEMPLATE, dependencies: [UiSelect, UiSelectTrigger, UiSelectContent, UiSelectItem, UiSelectGroup, UiSelectLabel], }) export class SelectDemo { fruit = '' }
